title: Antisocial Analagous Behavior, Alignment and Human Impact of Google AI Systems: Evaluating through the lens of modified Antisocial Behavior Criteria by Human Interaction, Independent LLM Analysis, and AI Self-Reflection
reasoning: The paper is fundamentally an ethical evaluation of AI systems. It proposes and applies a framework based on modified clinical criteria for Antisocial Personality Disorder (ASPD) to assess the alignment, morality, and ethical conduct of Large Language Models and the corporate environments that produce them.
